raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Product Manager with 8.5+ years of experience building and scaling B2B and B2C SaaS products across construction, healthcare, telecom, banking, and eCommerce. Proven in defining product vision, executing roadmaps, and delivering measurable outcomes such as 50–75% efficiency gains, 60%+ user retention, and double-digit adoption growth. Strong in customer discovery, stakeholder alignment, and Agile delivery, with experience driving cloud-based product evolution and leveraging Generative AI to improve productivity and business impact.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Competencies:
Product Management & Strategy: Product vision and roadmapping, MVP definition, market and user research, Generative AI Product Ownership, Requirement Gathering, A/B testing, Sprint Planning, and Go-to-market (GTM) execution. Experienced in Epics, Features, User Stories, PRDs, BRDs, and FRDs. • Owned and delivered Agentic AI product capabilities using autonomous AI workflows to automate document analysis, reasoning, and user interactions across enterprise SaaS use cases.
Agile & Delivery: Hands-on experience with Scrum and Kanban, backlog prioritization, sprint ceremonies, cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder management, and end-to-end Agile delivery. • Designed and implemented RAG-based solutions using OpenAI/LLM technologies, integrating enterprise documents and knowledge sources to generate context-aware responses and improve product intelligence.
Led hands-on development and productization of OpenAI-powered GenAI features, working closely with engineering teams on prompt design, retrieval workflows, evaluation, and production deployment.
Product Execution: End-to-end product lifecycle ownership, feature prioritization, Prioritization Frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, Kano), OKRs, Roadmap execution, UAT, release management, and post- launch performance tracking.
Data & Metrics: Definition and tracking of product KPIs, user engagement and retention metrics, funnel analysis, ROI and cost-benefit analysis, and executive reporting.
Technical & Platforms: Working knowledge of API Design and Integrations, Data Modeling, Python, Cloud Platform (AWS, GCP, Azure), Data Analytics (SQL, Tableau, Power BI), Cloud SQL, SaaS architectures, Microservices, CI/CD exposure, Schema Designs and GenAI-enabled product features.
Tools & Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Figma, Aha! , Git, Smartsheet, Swagger, Tableau, Miro, Microsoft teams, Google Analytics, MS Excel, Google Sheets and MS Project.
Delivery & Client Engagement: Strong record of on-time delivery, risk/gap analysis, and building long- term client partnerships, positioning organizations as trusted partners over vendors.
Domains: Banking, Healthcare, Telecom, eCommerce, Construction, Travel, Education, and Cloud- based enterprise platforms.

Professional Experience:
Persistent Systems (Bengaluru) Product Manager / Product Owner - (July 2024 - Present)
Project Name: Akordi Client: Laing O’Rourke | Role: Product Manager| Team Size: 30| Duration: July 2024 – Present Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Akordi is a web-based progressive application developed for engineers in the construction industry to streamline their daily activities. It centralizes data from ongoing Laing O’Rourke projects and assigns user-specific workspaces, enabling engineers to access and contribute project-related information collaboratively within their teams. Designed with a user-focused approach, the platform integrates generative AI to interpret uploaded documents and provide intelligent responses, supporting enhanced productivity and paving the way for future growth through AI-driven innovations.
Responsibilities:
Owned product roadmap and execution for a GenAI-enabled SaaS platform used by engineers.
Drove a 50% improvement in client retention by prioritizing high-impact workflows and AI- assisted document intelligence.
Defined MVP scope, success metrics, and phased roadmap aligned with business outcomes and adoption goals.

Led stakeholder and client requirement analysis to validate problem statements, drive feature prioritization, and ensure alignment with business goals.
Partnered with cross-functional and distributed teams (engineering, design, sales) to deliver bi- weekly releases through Agile ceremonies.
Defined and prioritized the AI product roadmap covering Agentic AI, RAG, LLM and intelligent automation capabilities, translating customer/business requirements into scalable AI features and measurable product outcomes
Created and maintained documentation including FRD, BRD, SRS, epics, and user stories to ensure clear communication across teams.
Established KPI tracking and ROI analysis to guide investment decisions and executive reporting.

Project Name: OmniLink Client: ConnectSphere, Horizon Networks | Role: Product Manager / Product Owner | Team Size: 20 | Duration: June 2022 – March 2023| Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, APIs, Swagger, SQL
Description: OmniLink is a next-gen telecom order management and service provisioning platform built for major telecom providers, ConnectSphere and Horizon Networks. It streamlined customer onboarding across broadband, mobile, and VoIP services by unifying service journeys and automating backend provisioning. The platform integrated with legacy OSS/BSS systems, enabling real-time tracking, reducing manual interventions, and significantly improving service activation timelines and customer experience.

Managed the design and delivery of a cloud-based order management platform, reducing provisioning time by 75%.
Defined the product roadmap and MVP in alignment with business goals and customer pain points.

Mediaagility Pvt. Ltd (Acquired by Persistent Systems) Product Owner - (Jan 2021 – March 2022)
Project Name: SP Portal Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations, supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.
Responsibilities
Gathered and analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and translated them into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Defined project scope, timelines, and strategies; facilitated stakeholder meetings and workshops for requirement clarification.
Acted as a liaison between business, QA, and development teams, ensuring defect resolution, quality delivery, and smooth release cycles.
Planned and executed UAT, analyzed gaps, and recommended process improvements for better business outcomes.
Utilized tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Katalon Studio for documentation, traceability, and process optimization.
Project Name: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations Client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git
Description: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations is a progressive web application developed for internal use within Whirlpool. It supports three distinct user roles—Admin, Editor, and General User— each with role-specific access and permissions. The application serves as a centralized platform to display ongoing organizational projects, offering complete project details, trending updates, quick links, and progress reports. It also includes features such as user location tracking to enhance visibility. Designed to be user-friendly, the application ensures a seamless experience across mobile, desktop, and tablet devices, with the goal of improving accessibility and engagement for all users.
Responsibilities
Analysed system specifications and translated requirements into detailed documentation, scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinated with developers, QA, and clients to track defects, ensure quality, and deliver seamless product releases.

Led multi-device, cross-platform verification, UAT planning, and execution to validate business needs.
Supported automation initiatives and database validations, recommending improvements for better system performance.
Project Name: Cadent Client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021 – Jan 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas connections across European regions, ensuring seamless customer service delivery. The platform allows users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.
Responsibilities
Analysed business needs, created BRDs, FRDs, workflows, and user stories, and defined acceptance criteria for development.
Collaborated with stakeholders, developers, and QA to ensure requirement clarity, defect resolution, and smooth releases.
Conducted gap analysis, UAT planning, and data validation to deliver a seamless, cross-platform customer experience.

Project Name: Chibbs Client: Chibbs | Role: Software Engineer | Team Size: 12 | Duration: Aug 2019 – Dec 2021 | Environment: JIRA, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Chibbs is an online marketplace for homemade food, offering customers a seamless experience similar to platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. The app provides a wide range of cuisines, supports multiple payment methods (debit/credit cards, UPI, wallets, COD), and includes dedicated interfaces for buyers, sellers, and delivery partners.
